title: Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO Details
intro:
Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO is a book build issue of ₹475.48 crores. The issue is entirely an offer for sale of 1.38 crore shares of ₹475.48 crore.

Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO opens for subscription on Oct 15, 2026 and closes on Oct 19, 2026. The allotment for the Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 21, 2026. Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 23, 2026.

Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO is set issue price band at ₹327 to ₹344 per share. The lot size for an application is 43 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,792 (43 shares) (based on upper price).

Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Incorporated in October 2001, Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited is a medical technology company engaged in the development, manufacturing and marketing of technologically advanced medical devices, primarily focused on vascular intervention and structural heart intervention. Its product portfolio includes coronary stents, coronary balloons, transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) devices, occluders, renal stents and peripheral drug-coated balloons (DCBs). The Company focuses on research and development, precision manufacturing and clinically supported product innovation. Its flagship brands include Supraflex Cruz, Cocoon and Hydra, serving different areas of interventional cardiology.

The Company operates three manufacturing facilities, two in India and one in Thailand, supported by two R&D centres in India and Thailand. As of June 30, 2026, it had 119 patents granted globally, 78 patent applications in the pipeline and five design registrations in India. Its products were marketed in 77 countries in Fiscal 2026, through direct, hybrid and distributor-led models, with established market presence in India, Europe and other international markets.

The Company reported revenue from operations of ₹12,105.04 million in Fiscal 2026, compared with ₹10,248.79 million in Fiscal 2025 and ₹9,016.04 million in Fiscal 2024.

As of June 30, 2026, it had 1,605 full-time employees, 31 consultants and 707 contract-based employees.

Sahajanand Medical Technologies Ltd.'s revenue increased by 18% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 175% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

The Sahajanand Medical Technologies Ltd. IPO is a 100% Offer for Sale (OFS), so the company will not receive any funding and the entire IPO proceeds will go to the selling shareholders.

Company Promoters: Bhargav Dhirajlal Kotadia, Dhirajlal Vallabhbhai Kotadia, Priyanka Dhirajlal Cohen and Shree Hari Trust.

faqs.question: How to apply in Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
